The hand artifact is the most significant structural flaw, typical of AI generation, but it does not detract significantly from the primary subject (the sarong). The severity of the hand artifact is moderate (2.0) as it is peripheral to the main class definition.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly conforms to the 'sarong' class. The only minor deduction is for the lack of definitive hemming visibility (untestable) and slight texture syntheticness, but these do not break class conformance.
artifact_reasoning: The image is free of catastrophic structural failures. The primary artifacts are minor: a slightly smudged/untextured yellow sash and fused finger tips on the right hand.
